entry.title: coralbricks: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash FP4 takes image input; retire GPT-OS…
entry.content:
coralbricks: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash FP4 takes image input; retire GPT-OSS 120B (#7771)

* coralbricks: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash FP4 takes image input

The entry overrode the base model's attachment and modalities to text-only.
CoralBricks enabled image input for this model on 2026-09-21, and /v1/models
now reports supports_image_input: true for it.

Verified live: a chat/completions request whose user message carries an
image_url part is answered from the image. Dropping the two overrides lets
the deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash base supply attachment = true and
input = ["text", "image"], which is what every other provider of this model
inherits.

The reasoning note is re-verified on the same date: low, high and max return
reasoning_content (299 / 725 / 1810 reasoning tokens on one prompt), none and
no field return 0.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* coralbricks: drop GPT-OSS 120B

CoralBricks retired the model on 2026-09-22. It is gone from /v1/models and
from the public catalog, and a chat/completions request for it answers 404,
so the entry only advertised a model no key can reach.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

entry.title: umans-ai: add DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, drop V4 Pro 0813 (sunset 2026-09-1…
entry.content:
umans-ai: add DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, drop V4 Pro 0813 (sunset 2026-09-14) (#7385)

* umans-ai + coding-plan: add DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (release 2026-09-18)

Add umans-deepseek-v4.1-flash (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, 552B MoE with 8B
active on prefill / 16B on decode, native image understanding, 1M
context) to both Umans providers: pay-per-token at Umans AI's public
rate ($0.15/$0.60/$0.028 per 1M) on umans-ai, cost 0 on the coding
plan (the plan convention). Reasoning is toggle + effort low|high|max
(default high), matching the live can_disable=true card.

* umans-ai + coding-plan: reviewer nits — leading wire-path comments on the V4.1 toggle (thinking.type / reasoning_effort), drop redundant name override

Both new entries carried { type = "toggle" } without the leading
top-of-file wire-path comments AGENTS.md requires (sync strips
mid-file comments): add "# Toggle: thinking.type = enabled|disabled"
and "# Effort: reasoning_effort = low|high|max" as the first lines of
each file, matching the V4 Flash 0731 peers whose family dispatch the
V4.1 id rides. Also drop name = "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash" from both
provider files — it restated models/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.toml
verbatim, so the base name is now inherited.

* umans-ai + coding-plan: drop DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (sunset 2026-09-14)

The V4 Pro 0813 pay-per-token release reached its sunset (2026-09-14,
announced 00353) and entered the removal phase (llm-gateway 00358):
deprecated: true unlists the id from /v1/models + /v1/models/info while
it stays routable for the grace tail; PAST_MODELS carries the record
with the successor repointed to umans-deepseek-v4.1-flash — the
DeepSeek lineage's own successor, added in this PR. No remaining alias
routes to the dropped id (umans-flash rides Qwen3.6 35B A3B, umans-coder
rides GLM 5.3 Flash).

entry.title: feat(302ai): add gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol (#7853)
entry.content:
feat(302ai): add gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol (#7853)

* feat(302ai): add gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol

302.AI serves OpenAI GPT-6 Luna and Sol (2026-09-22 release) via base_model
to the lab metadata already in models/openai. Costs match the 302.AI
catalog: luna $0.10/$0.50, sol $2.00/$10.00 per MTok. Effort surface
none|low|medium|high|xhigh|max, consistent with the 302.AI GPT peer set;
live probes on the OpenAI direct surface return reasoning=null (no
reasoning_content side channel), so no interleaved override.

* fix(302ai): add cache pricing for gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol

Review bot flagged missing cache costs. 302.AI lists cache creation at
1.25x input (luna $0.125, sol $2.5) and cache read at 0.1x input (luna
$0.01, sol $0.2), matching the OpenAI pricing schedule.

entry.content:
feat(302ai): add claude-opus-5-5 and grok-4.7 (#7958)

302.AI serves both models (released 2026-09-21/22) via base_model to lab
metadata already on dev. Prices from 302.AI product pages: claude-opus-5-5
$4/$20 (cache read $0.2, cache write $5), grok-4.7 $2/$6 (cache read
$0.5, cache write $0.5) per MTok.

Live probes on api.302ai.cn:
- claude-opus-5-5: Anthropic native Messages surface; effort via
  output_config.effort (low..max verified, none rejected); thinking
  toggle not exposed -> effort only.
- grok-4.7: reasoning_effort low|medium|high|xhigh (none rejected);
  returns reasoning_content side channel -> [interleaved].
